paper_title: Search for Axion dark matter with the QUAX-LNF tunable haloscope
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, 90% single-sided C.L. upper limit
notes: QUAX-LNF tunable haloscope first run: OFHC Cu cavity at 30 mK in 8 T field, scanning 8.831496-8.83803 GHz (36.52413-36.5511 ueV). No detailed limit table provided; the paper quotes only the best 90% CL upper limit g_agamma < 0.882e-13 GeV^-1 (paper body/v3 value; the provided abstract shows 0.861e-13, superseded by 0.882e-13 in text and conclusions). Data points represent the quoted best limit across the stated mass window; the actual exclusion curve (Fig. 7) varies around this value. Assumes rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and standard halo model (Q_a ~ 1e6). Paper also recasts a dark photon kinetic mixing limit (Fig. 8, random polarization, cos theta = 1/sqrt(3)), but the primary result is the axion-photon coupling. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 70)) | Vision: Fig. 7 top panel (fig_00.png): 90% C.L. upper limit on g_agamma from QUAX-LNF haloscope over 36.52413-36.5511 ueV (8.831-8.838 GHz). The boundary is highly jagged (per-tuning-step fluctuations ~9e-14 to ~2e-13 GeV^-1 with occasional spikes to ~3-4e-13); the traced points represent the envelope of these fluctuations rather than every fine spike.
